items.title: 3 Reasons LH is Risky and 1 Stock to Buy Instead
items.summary: Over the past six months, Labcorp has been a great trade, beating the S&P 500 by 9.5%. Its stock price has climbed to $339.34, representing a healthy 20% increase. This was partly thanks to its solid quarterly results, and the run-up might have investors contemplating their next move.

items.title: Danaher Rides on Strength in Biotechnology Segment: Will It Sustain?
items.summary: DHR's Biotechnology segment grows as China demand, bioprocessing and improving discovery markets offset regional headwinds.

items.title: Should You Continue to Hold Labcorp Stock in Your Portfolio?
items.summary: LH's specialty-testing expansion, strategic partnerships and buybacks support growth, while reimbursement and cost pressures pose risks.

items.title: Hims & Hers Health Stock Trades Below The Market On Revenue And Above It On Cash
items.summary: The gap between its revenue multiple and its cash multiple is margin, and the company is spending it on purpose.

items.title: IDXX Raises 2026 EPS Outlook as Diagnostic Growth and Margins Improve
items.summary: IDEXX raises its 2026 EPS outlook as recurring diagnostics growth, wider margins and international expansion offset softer U.S. veterinary traffic.

items.summary: OPKO Health's 12.4% monthly gain is backed by narrower losses and better margins, though profitability and clinical execution remain key risks.

items.title: New Study Reveals Strongest State Economies, Only 1 State Was Better Than Texas
items.summary: CNBC's 20th annual state business rankings handed the overall crown to Ohio for the first time ever, but in the critical economy sub-category it was a two-state race: North Carolina led the nation and Texas came in second, even as the Lone Star State carries more foreign investment than any other top-10 economy in the country.

items.summary: Bio-Techne's Q4 revenues beat estimates as Diagnostics and Spatial Biology deliver strong organic growth, while its Merck deal remains in focus.
